title: Battle of Al-Buweib (The field of Tens)
description: Al-Muthanna awaited the Persian army at Al-Buweib on the western branch of the Euphrates, close by the future site of Al-Kufa, letting them cross the bridge before fighting during the fast of Ramadan. A charge with the Christian tribe broke the Persian centre, a Beni Taghlib youth slew the Persian leader Mihran, and the Persians, cut off from the bridge, were slaughtered into the night. Al-Muthanna's brother and the Christian chieftain died, and great stores of grain and cattle were taken. Dated to the year 0634 by the source.

sources.citation: Sir William Muir, The Caliphate: Its Rise, Decline, and Fall, "A. IT. 13-14."
